extraction.agency_name: Regional Institute for Children and Adolescents – Baltimore
extraction.parent_department: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene

findings.title: Cash receipts were not always deposited timely.
findings.description: RICA did not deposit cash receipts totaling approximately $1.8 million during fiscal year 2013 in a timely manner. Testing of 44 checks totaling approximately $912,000 revealed 30 checks totaling approximately $484,000 were deposited two to ten business days after receipt, violating Comptroller requirements for one-day deposit.

dollar_amounts.context: total cash receipts during fiscal year 2013

findings.recommendation: We recommend that RICA a. ensure that all cash receipts are deposited in a timely manner, as required; and b. pursue the use of electronic funds transfer for payments from local jurisdictions.

findings.title: RICA did not comply with State procurement regulations when purchasing dietary items.
findings.description: RICA purchased dietary items directly from one vendor without considering availability and pricing from Department of General Services’ approved statewide contracts as required. Testing of 12 disbursements totaling approximately $150,000 disclosed two disbursements for dietary items to the same vendor totaling $27,370 for which RICA did not have a contract.

dollar_amounts.context: total payments to vendor during period

findings.recommendation: We recommend that RICA comply with State procurement regulations with respect to using statewide contracts and, in the absence of a statewide contract, ensuring procurements are properly solicited and documented.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The agency concurred with both findings and recommendations. For cash receipts, they agreed to deposit after the day of receipt no later than the first working day or weekly for $500+. For procurement, they agreed to ensure regulations are documented/solicited, use statewide contracts when applicable, post solicitations to eMaryland Marketplace, and award contracts over $25,000 via competitive sealed bidding.
extraction.extraction_notes: Report date derived from header 'June 2014'. Prior findings count based on singular reference 'the finding' in preceding report status section. No criminal referral or hotline origin stated.
